About Daydream Meadow Oak 5mm w/pad

5mm w/pad Daydream Meadow Oak Waterproof Rigid Vinyl Plank Flooring 6 in. Wide x 48 in. Long

Lifetime Warranty

Prepare for your home décor dreams to take flight, and your grand design vision to take shape, with our Daydream Meadow Oak vinyl flooring. This floor’s soothing gray-tan tones can bring an instant sense of calm—setting the stage for you and your family to unwind and free your minds from the stresses of day-to-day drudgery. Subtle character marks and textures complete this floor’s comforting aura, and that serene aesthetic makes it a versatile option—capable of meshing with all manner of interior design aesthetics. If you’re looking for a floor that can help transform your space into the paradise you’ve always longed for, look no further than Daydream Meadow Oak.

DIY-ers will love how simple our click installation method makes it to lay these planks. Daydream Meadow Oak comes with a high-density, pre-attached pad that will help to dampen sound. For increased sound reduction and comfort, you could also consider installing an additional underlayment. It's safe to lay these planks over radiant heat, as long as they do not come into direct contact with the heat source. Vinyl flooring is easy to maintain and clean, making it a worry-free choice if you have kids and pets. We suggest Bellawood Floor Cleaner to keep your floors looking their best; with regular maintenance, they’ll stay beautiful for the duration of their lifetime.

  • Installation grade: Above Grade, On Grade, Below Grade
  • Installation Type: Click
  • Width: 5.9 in.
  • Length: 48.03 in.
  • Thickness: 5mm
  • Wear Layer: 6 mils
  • Kid and Pet Proof—our SPC rigid vinyl flooring brings you our best dent resistance. Learn More!
  • High-density IXPE pad attached to waterproof plank
  • Backed by a lifetime residential warranty, and a 10-year limited light commercial warranty

In support of healthy home environments, Tranquility and CoreLuxe vinyl flooring are phthalate-safe.

Underlayment

QuietWalk Max, EcoSilencer Max, & QuietWalk Versa underlayments are recommended for use under Vinyl flooring. QuietBoard underlayment is also recommended with the use of our waterproof Underlayment Seal Tape on the seams to maintain the warranty. These quality underlayments help smooth out minor subfloor imperfections, provide moisture protection over wood subfloors or concrete (Class 1 vapor protection or 6mil Poly attached), and have added insulation and sound control properties.

This floor is waterproof, however, moisture intrusions from concrete via hydrostatic pressure, flooding, or plumbing leaks, along with high levels of alkalinity, can affect floor coverings over time.

Moisture can also be trapped below the flooring and create mildew or mold.
